terminals.name: web-api
terminals.command: cd /workspace && source .venv/bin/activate && WEBAPI_HOST=127.0.0.1 WEBAPI_PORT=8000 CLIENT_TZ=UTC mtdata-webapi
terminals.description: mtdata FastAPI backend: REST API plus the built React UI at http://127.0.0.1:8000/app/. MT5 data endpoints require a Windows MetaTrader 5 terminal and report a graceful 'not connected' status here.
